使用管理员为你创建的账户登录。: Sign in with the account created by your administrator.
保存后用于新发起的任务；已开始的任务沿用启动时的配置。: Applies to new tasks. Running tasks retain their initial settings.
保存新密码并退出该用户的所有登录: Save password and sign out all user sessions

在右侧查看文件、执行进度和代码差异。: View files, progress and code changes on the right.

密码已重置，该用户需重新登录: Password reset; user must sign in again

文件仅限授权工作区: Files limited to the authorized workspace

点击 ＋ 创建或导入项目: Click ＋ to create or import a project
编辑时留空保留原密钥: Leave blank to keep the existing key
设置仅对当前账户生效，保存后立即应用。: Settings apply only to your account and take effect when saved.
请在管理控制台配置模型: Configure a model in the admin console
支持服务器上的绝对目录路径；相对路径基于 --workspace 指定的工作区（: Use an absolute directory path on the server, or a path relative to --workspace (default: var/workspace).
选择一个项目，配置模型，然后描述你想实现的功能。: Choose a project, configure a model, then describe what to build.
选择厂商预设会新建配置，自动填写接口和默认模型；填写自己的 API Key 后保: A preset creates a new configuration with endpoint and model filled in. Add your API key and save. Presets match webcool and remain editable.
选择文件查看内容: Select a file to view its contents
项目已就绪。你希望实现什么？: Project ready. What would you like to build?
首次使用，请创建管理员账户。随后可在管理控制台创建普通用户。密码至少 10 字节: Create the first administrator, then add users in the admin console. Passwords need at least 10 bytes.
修改后请先预览差异，再确认保存。: Preview changes before confirming the save.
文件已被其他任务修改，请重新打开后编辑。: File changed elsewhere. Reopen it before editing.
差异已生成，确认后保存。: Changes ready for review. Confirm to save.
生成的文件先保存在修订区；在“变更”中接受后写入正式项目目录。: Generated files stay in revisions until accepted in Changes.
生成成果尚未写入正式目录，请接受变更后使用。: Generated changes have not been written to the project. Accept them first.
全部接受并写入项目: Accept all and write to project
当前浏览器不支持全屏，请使用最大化。: Full screen is unavailable in this browser. Use Maximize instead.

单个附件需为 1 字节至 8 MiB，合计不超过 16 MiB: Each attachment must be 1 byte–8 MiB, up to 16 MiB total
图片支持 PNG、JPEG、GIF 和 WebP: Images: PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP
文本附件合计不超过 32 KiB，不支持二进制文档: Text attachments must total at most 32 KiB. Binary documents are not supported.
可粘贴、拖入图片或文本文件；图片需模型支持视觉。: Paste or drop images or text files. Images require a vision-capable model.
请根据附件完成任务: Please complete the task using the attachments

差异视图已关闭，修改及审核状态仍保留。: Diff views are closed. Changes and review status are preserved.
任务失败，请查看回复中的原因: Task failed. See the reply for details.
成果已生成，等待确认写入: Changes prepared; awaiting approval to write
任务处理结束，请查看最终回复: Processing finished. See the final reply.
文件修改已暂存，尚未写入正式目录: Changes staged; not yet written to the project
正在等待或接收模型回复: Waiting for or receiving the model reply

目录较多，仅显示部分内容；可输入完整路径打开目录。: Only part of this directory is shown. Enter a full path to open a directory.
无法读取目录，请检查路径和访问权限。: Cannot read this directory. Check the path and access permissions.

文件不属于当前项目: This file does not belong to the current project
查看项目的执行状态与历史结果: Review execution status and past results

会话已保存到项目目录: Session saved to the project directory
